# Capability reference

Fluidian 1.2.0 ships **185 capabilities** in **15 families**. Each one is declared once in the engine and is available to every SDK, either attached to a component with `.ai("id")` or called from a handler with `ctx.ai("id", input)`.

| Kind | Count | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| model | 122 | Answered by the model through strict Structured Outputs; a Reflex implementation answers offline. |
| hybrid | 19 | The engine computes the facts deterministically; the model only writes the narrative around them. |
| direct | 44 | Computed entirely by the engine. No model call, no tokens, identical online and offline. |

## Surfaces

The surface is how a result reaches the screen when the capability is attached to a component.

| Surface | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `ghost` | Inline ghost text inside the field; Tab accepts. |
| `rewrite` | A ✦ menu on the field offers the transformation with a before/after preview. |
| `validate` | A coaching message under the field, updated on blur. |
| `fill` | Writes the resolved value (or several field values) into the form. |
| `suggest` | Chips or a ranked list rendered next to the component. |
| `annotate` | An insight panel attached to the component, with confidence and provenance. |
| `transform` | Replaces the component's text in place; a provenance badge allows reverting. |
| `compose` | Renders the returned scene inside the component. |
| `ask` | A popover answers questions about the element or screen. |
| `command` | The Intent Bar executes the matched action. |
| `chat` | Streaming replies inside the Copilot component. |
| `audit` | A findings list with severities; selecting a finding highlights its target. |
| `theme` | Applies design tokens to the document. |
| `media` | Produces or consumes audio and images. |
| `observe` | Runs on interaction signals and returns adaptation directives. |
| `service` | Invoked from application code, the CLI or the developer tools. |

| [`compose.variant_lab`](capabilities/compose.md#composevariant_lab--variant-lab) | Variant Lab | model | `service` | Proposes A/B variants for a screen, each with a hypothesis, the concrete change and its risk. |

| [`flow.approval`](capabilities/flow.md#flowapproval--risk-rated-approval) | Risk-Rated Approval | model | `compose` | Rates the risk of an agent-proposed action and renders a human-in-the-loop approval card. |
| [`flow.timeline`](capabilities/flow.md#flowtimeline--agent-activity-timeline) | Agent Activity Timeline | model | `annotate` | Explains what an agent did, step by step, in language a non-engineer can audit. |
| [`flow.decompose`](capabilities/flow.md#flowdecompose--task-decomposition-board) | Task Decomposition Board | model | `compose` | Breaks a goal into concrete tasks and lays them out as a Now / Next / Later board. |
| [`flow.handoff`](capabilities/flow.md#flowhandoff--handoff-summary) | Handoff Summary | model | `service` | Writes the note a colleague needs to take over a task: state, decisions, open questions, next step. |
| [`flow.rules`](capabilities/flow.md#flowrules--rule-builder) | Rule Builder | model | `service` | Converts “when X happens, do Y” into a structured automation rule bound to registered actions. |
| [`flow.batch`](capabilities/flow.md#flowbatch--batch-by-description) | Batch-by-Description | hybrid | `service` | Selects the records a bulk operation applies to from a description, and previews the impact before anything runs. |
| [`flow.review`](capabilities/flow.md#flowreview--pre-submit-review) | Pre-Submit Review | model | `validate` | Reads a completed form as a careful colleague would and flags inconsistencies before submission. |
| [`flow.recover`](capabilities/flow.md#flowrecover--error-recovery-guide) | Error Recovery Guide | model | `annotate` | Turns a failure into a recovery path: what happened, what is safe, what to do next. |
| [`flow.checkpoint`](capabilities/flow.md#flowcheckpoint--named-checkpoints) | Named Checkpoints | model | `service` | Names a point in a session from what changed, so people can return to “before I changed the pricing table”. |

### [Trust, Safety & Governance](capabilities/trust.md)

The guarantees that make generated interfaces safe to ship.

| Capability | Title | Kind | Surface | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`trust.redact`](capabilities/trust.md#trustredact--pii-redaction-gate) | PII Redaction Gate | direct | `service` | Replaces personal data and secrets with reversible placeholders before any text leaves the engine, and restores them in the result. |
| [`trust.injection_shield`](capabilities/trust.md#trustinjection_shield--prompt-injection-shield) | Prompt-Injection Shield | direct | `service` | Scores user-supplied content for instruction-injection patterns and fences it as data inside every prompt. |
| [`trust.moderate`](capabilities/trust.md#trustmoderate--moderation-gate) | Moderation Gate | direct | `service` | Screens user-generated text before it is processed or displayed, using the moderation endpoint or a local screen. |
| [`trust.provenance`](capabilities/trust.md#trustprovenance--provenance-ledger) | Provenance Ledger | direct | `service` | Records provider, model, latency, cache status and repairs for every result, and exposes it to badges and audits. |
| [`trust.confidence`](capabilities/trust.md#trustconfidence--confidence-calibration) | Confidence Calibration | direct | `annotate` | Maps model confidence to a band and a presentation rule: show plainly, hedge, or ask for confirmation. |
| [`trust.explain`](capabilities/trust.md#trustexplain--explain-why) | Explain-Why | model | `ask` | Explains an automated decision in plain language from the evidence that produced it. |
| [`trust.budget`](capabilities/trust.md#trustbudget--budget-governor) | Budget Governor | direct | `service` | Enforces per-session and global token budgets and degrades to the Reflex path instead of failing when they are exhausted. |
| [`trust.replay`](capabilities/trust.md#trustreplay--deterministic-record--replay) | Deterministic Record & Replay | direct | `service` | Records model responses and replays them byte-for-byte, so tests and audits never depend on a live model. |
| [`trust.consent`](capabilities/trust.md#trustconsent--consent-gates) | Consent Gates | direct | `service` | Requires explicit, revocable consent before capabilities that use the microphone or behavioural personalisation run. |
| [`trust.grounding`](capabilities/trust.md#trustgrounding--hallucination-guard) | Hallucination Guard | direct | `service` | Validates generated scenes against the component catalogue and registered actions, removing anything invented. |
| [`trust.feedback`](capabilities/trust.md#trustfeedback--feedback-loop) | Feedback Loop | direct | `service` | Captures thumbs up/down on generated results and feeds recent corrections back into later prompts. |
| [`trust.policy`](capabilities/trust.md#trustpolicy--capability-policy) | Capability Policy | direct | `service` | Allows or denies capabilities by id or category from configuration, with the reason reported to callers. |

### [Intelligence Infrastructure](capabilities/perf.md)

Caching, routing, streaming and resilience for model-backed UI.

| Capability | Title | Kind | Surface | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`perf.semantic_cache`](capabilities/perf.md#perfsemantic_cache--semantic-cache) | Semantic Cache | direct | `service` | Serves repeated and near-identical requests from memory: exact matches by hash, paraphrases by embedding similarity. |
| [`perf.stream_scene`](capabilities/perf.md#perfstream_scene--streaming-scenes) | Streaming Scenes | direct | `service` | Renders interfaces progressively while the model is still writing, by repairing partial JSON into valid scenes. |
| [`perf.router`](capabilities/perf.md#perfrouter--model-router) | Model Router | direct | `service` | Maps capability tiers to the best available model, discovering what the account can reach and falling back down a chain. |
| [`perf.speculate`](capabilities/perf.md#perfspeculate--speculative-precompute) | Speculative Precompute | direct | `service` | Runs likely-next requests in the background so their results are already cached when asked for. |
| [`perf.reflex`](capabilities/perf.md#perfreflex--reflex-path) | Reflex Path | direct | `service` | Gives every capability a local, deterministic implementation that answers in milliseconds — offline, in tests, or while the model thinks. |
| [`perf.resilience`](capabilities/perf.md#perfresilience--circuit-breaker--backoff) | Circuit Breaker & Backoff | direct | `service` | Retries transient failures with backoff, opens a breaker on repeated ones, and fails over to the next model or Reflex. |
| [`perf.digest`](capabilities/perf.md#perfdigest--scene-digest-compression) | Scene Digest Compression | direct | `service` | Compresses a scene into a compact outline — structure, text, bindings — so screens fit in a prompt at a fraction of the tokens. |
| [`perf.coalesce`](capabilities/perf.md#perfcoalesce--request-coalescing) | Request Coalescing | direct | `service` | Merges identical in-flight requests into one provider call and shares the result. |
| [`perf.telemetry`](capabilities/perf.md#perftelemetry--cost--latency-telemetry) | Cost & Latency Telemetry | direct | `service` | Tracks calls, errors, cache hits, token use and latency percentiles per capability. |
| [`perf.repair`](capabilities/perf.md#perfrepair--structured-output-self-repair) | Structured-Output Self-Repair | direct | `service` | Recovers truncated or malformed model output, validates it against the schema, and re-asks with the exact errors when needed. |
| [`perf.negotiate`](capabilities/perf.md#perfnegotiate--adaptive-parameter-negotiation) | Adaptive Parameter Negotiation | direct | `service` | Learns each model's request dialect — token limits, instruction role, reasoning and response-format support — and adapts automatically. |
| [`perf.embed_index`](capabilities/perf.md#perfembed_index--embedding-index) | Embedding Index | direct | `service` | A built-in vector store: index documents once, query by meaning, with local embeddings offline and model embeddings when live. |
